# checkpointsase_web_categories (Data Source)

List the Web categories Check Point SASE recognises, for use in Internet Access (SWG) policy. This is a read-only product catalog: it is the same for every tenant and no tenant operation adds to or removes from it. The endpoint accepts no filter or pagination parameters, so this data source returns the whole catalog in one read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "checkpointsase_web_categories" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `web_categories` (List of Object) The list of Web categories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--web_categories))
